W.note: Desktop has a sticky bag panel with totals and free-shipping hint, but tall square art tiles make the grid sprawl, and on mobile the bag sits below every product so checkout is buried.

X.note: Strongest state coverage (sold-out variants, stock limits, busy and error labels, live announcements, focus-trapped drawer that becomes a bottom sheet on mobile), though the blue accent is a little default and the mobile grid leaves an orphaned card.

Y.note: Monochrome placeholder art, hairline rules and a dense four-column desktop grid read as the most restrained, but on mobile each card fills a screen so the footprint balloons and the Notify me link is a stub.

Z.note: Gradient initial tiles, badges and star ratings read as a generic e-commerce template, the five-column tiles are large, and cards offer no variant choice or quantity before adding.
